# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Around 13 years old  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with rosy cheeks and a merry expression inherited from her father. She has black eyes and glossy black hair.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)_

## Personality

Diana is a friendly, cheerful, and agreeable girl who laughs easily. She is well-mannered and ladylike, though she readily joins in play and imaginative games with her friends. She is deeply loyal, straightforward, and sensitive to proper behavior, initially hesitating at anything that seems improper.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c12 P34](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0034), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081)_

- Music lessons  <sub>[v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083)</sub>

## Goals

- To build playhouses and spend time playing with Anne  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- To take music lessons  <sub>[v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry lived at her family's home near Green Gables, spending much of her time reading books, which her father encouraged despite her mother's concerns. When Anne Shirley arrived at Green Gables, Mrs. Barry brought Diana over to meet her in hopes of giving her a local playmate. Meeting in the garden, Anne asked Diana to be her sworn bosom friend, and Diana agreed, taking a solemn vow of friendship. The two girls quickly became inseparable companions, planning playhouses and inventing games together, such as pretending the nearby spruce grove was a Haunted Wood. On one occasion, while staying at Green Gables, Diana participated in a playful jump onto a spare-room bed, inadvertently landing on visiting Aunt Josephine Barry, who became furious; Diana steadfastly refused to blame Anne for the idea.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v1 c20 P25](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0025)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Barry  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- Lives at Orchard Slope in Avonlea without any sisters close to her age  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>
- Born in February  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>

## Quotes

> Why, I guess so. I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

> Why it’s dreadfully wicked to swear,  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> You’re a queer girl, Anne. I heard before that you were queer. But I believe I’m going to like you real well.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> I’m no telltale, Anne Shirley, and anyhow I was just as much to blame as you.  <sub>[v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070)</sub>
